meta_description:
5,764 likes, 123 comments - wired on October 19, 2026: "Would you lie to this man?

EXCLUSIVE: Nathan Fielder, codirector of the Elizabeth Holmes documentary ‘You Can See Everything,’ sat down with WIRED for an extended interview—the first he’s given to discuss the film. What was it like living with Holmes in the weeks leading up to her incarceration? And who was really in control on set?

Read it in full at the 🔗 in our bio.

Photography by @keithoshiro
Styling by Katina Danabassis
Grooming by Jennifer Brent at Forward Artists using Chanel".
